content: {"like":["Sublime, beautiful, fragile, true moments in classic Japanese dramas like *Ikiru*","Atmospheric, slow‑paced storytelling in medieval mystery films such as *The Name of the Rose*","Excellent main casts and enjoyable action in superhero blockbusters like *X‑Men: Apocalypse*","Spectacular final fight scenes in epic superhero crossovers such as *Batman v Superman*","Great modern Western pacing and dialogue in contemporary Westerns like *Hell or High Water*"],"dislike":["Overblown, faithful-to-comic adaptations that lose heart, as in *X‑Men: Apocalypse*","Turgid, overlong pacing and missing emotional beats in superhero crossovers like *Batman v Superman*","Portrayals of iconic musicians as arrogant or fragile in music documentaries such as *Don’t Look Back*","Bombastic, tone‑deaf performances and stage‑like pacing in musical dramas like *Les Misérables*","Unlikable, niche characters and shallow romantic pursuits in indie comic‑adaptations like *Scott Pilgrim vs. The World*"]}
